title: How blockchain is quietly revolutionizing supply chains

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know your coffee might be tracked by blockchain?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Supply chains are breaking down with real-time transparency.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Blockchain creates an unchangeable record of every product’s journey.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Maersk uses it to cut shipping delays by 40% in just 6 months.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Farmers, retailers, and consumers get fairer deals and faster delivery.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway? Trust is now built into the system itself.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how this changes everything you buy?
